in_sanskrit.name: रुद्राला
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: A name for the wife of Rudra, the Hindu god of destruction.

in_hindi.name: रुद्राला

in_marathi.name: Rudrala
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Destruction
